chevron.$description: The drawer chevron and the nav logo width

popup.$description: Popups, dropdowns and hints slide in on this

box.$description: Height of the layout box in graph units; its width is 500 times the container's aspect ratio. The camera then fits this box to the screen.

log-base.$description: Count axes and node size use log(count + 1) / log(4). The settings offer 2, 4 and 8.

collision-tolerance.$description: Two nodes overlap when their centres are closer than 0.95 of touching.

collision-angle-step.$description: Radians per spiral step on the first ring (2π/6); later rings divide it by the ring count.

collision-ring-step.$description: Each full turn of the spiral grows its radius by this many node diameters.

collision-first-hit.$description: On the first overlap the node jumps this many diameters out from the blocker's centre.

recenter-pad-x.$description: Fraction of the viewport width kept clear on each side when fitting.

recenter-pad-y.$description: Fraction of the viewport height kept clear above and below when fitting.

recenter-pad-min.$description: The fit padding never goes below this.

$extensions.source: graph engine: 0.4 each when only one node (raw/graph-code-notes.md section 3.6)

recenter-zoom-divisor.$description: The fit may zoom in at most to the fit-all zoom divided by this.

few-min.$description: Smallest diameter, in graph units, when the graph has very few nodes.

few-max.$description: Largest diameter when the graph has very few nodes.

many-min.$description: Smallest diameter once the graph reaches the many-count.

many-max.$description: Largest diameter once the graph reaches the many-count.

many-count.$description: s = min(n / 150, 1) squared blends the two ranges.

$extensions.source: graph engine: Authors get a fixed 10 (raw/graph-code-notes.md section 1.3)

halo-gap.$description: A circle of radius r + 4 is erased (destination-out) before each node draws, so every node sits in a clear gap. Graph units, so the gap grows with zoom.

stroke.$description: The ring of a result node.

stroke-width.$description: Ring width of a node with no fill.
